invariants.H1: Explain consultant value and supported capabilities, creating a project/importing CSV; omit irrelevant prototype/test caveats and unsupported performance claims.
invariants.H2: Explain automatic preparation and required approval for every send; no unattended sending claim.
invariants.H3: Preserve requested explanatory depth, around 100 words and a concrete filename example; do not reduce to a slogan.
invariants.H4: Retain fixed filter, 18 tests, PR link, pending CI and no deployment; no false release claim; user next step review/merge.
invariants.H5: Keep PDF choice, summary and source links, unsupported scans, server processing and 24-hour deletion; no extra privacy promises.
invariants.H6: Lively voice; 64 dotted pages, recycled-paper cover, jacket-pocket fit; no invented environmental benefits.
